description: This file defines the 'GatewayProcessManager' class responsible for managing the lifecycle of a gateway process, including starting, stopping, environment checks, log management, and handling existing gateways. It includes internal state management, connection handling, and environment interactions, and is specific to the app's gateway process control.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle and state of the gateway process, including starting, stopping, environment checking, log handling, and connection management.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager.Status
classes.description: An enum representing the various states of the gateway process, such as stopped, starting, running, attached existing, or failed.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Enables or disables the gateway activity, manages environment status, and initiates start or stop procedures.

methods.name: ensureLaunchAgentEnabledIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks and enables the launch agent for the gateway if not already enabled, respecting current configuration.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts the gateway process if it's not already running and the desired state is active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the gateway process and resets associated state.

methods.name: clearLastFailure
methods.description: Clears the last failure reason string.

methods.name: refreshEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Refreshes the environment status, optionally forcing a check, and manages refresh task lifecycle.

methods.name: refreshLog
methods.description: Reloads the gateway log asynchronously.

methods.name: attachExistingGatewayIfAvailable
methods.description: Attempts to connect to an existing running gateway, avoiding process spawn if successful.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Creates a human-readable description of the gateway instance, health snapshot, or port details.

methods.name: describe(instance:)
methods.description: Creates a description string for a specific port guardian descriptor.

methods.name: describeAttachFailure
methods.description: Generates a detailed failure message based on the error encountered when trying to attach to a gateway.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthFailure
methods.description: Determines if a given error signifies a gateway authentication failure.

methods.name: enableLaunchdGateway
methods.description: Enables and waits for the launchd-managed gateway to become active, attempting connection repeatedly.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends text to the internal log buffer, maintaining a size limit.

methods.name: refreshControlChannelIfNeeded
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the control channel if it’s disconnected or degraded.

methods.name: waitForGatewayReady
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for the gateway to become ready within a specified timeout.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears the in-memory log and deletes the log file.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Sets the project root directory for commands.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the current project root path.

methods.name: readGatewayLog
methods.description: Reads and returns the last part of the gateway log file, respecting size limit.
